"""A report that could not be written is its own verdict, not 'could not check'.

The scanner has four outcomes and each names a different operator action: complete (nothing to do),
holes (backfill these days), cannot check (the archive is unreadable or unresolvable), report failed
(the scan is fine, the artifact a monitor binds to is not on disk). Collapsing the last two sends
the operator to inspect an archive that is perfectly healthy, and the actual failure, a --report
path that cannot be written, is never named.
"""
import completeness as C


def _archive(root, dates):
    arch = root / "archive"
    for d in dates:
        p = arch / "digests" / d[:4]
        p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (p / (d + ".md")).write_text("# synthetic digest %s\n" % d, encoding="utf-8")
    return arch


def test_report_write_failure_has_its_own_verdict(tmp_path):
    arch = _archive(tmp_path / "ok", ["2026-07-14", "2026-07-15"])

    rc_complete = C.main(["--archive-dir", str(arch),
                          "--start", "2026-07-14", "--end", "2026-07-15",
                          "--report", str(tmp_path / "out" / "completeness.json")])

    blocker = tmp_path / "blocker"
    blocker.write_text("i am a file, not a directory", encoding="utf-8")
    rc_report_failed = C.main(["--archive-dir", str(arch),
                               "--start", "2026-07-14", "--end", "2026-07-15",
                               "--report", str(blocker / "completeness.json")])

    rc_cannot = C.main(["--archive-dir", str(tmp_path / "there-is-no-archive-here"),
                        "--start", "2026-07-14", "--end", "2026-07-15"])

    holed = _archive(tmp_path / "holed", ["2026-07-14"])
    rc_holes = C.main(["--archive-dir", str(holed),
                       "--start", "2026-07-14", "--end", "2026-07-15"])

    assert rc_complete == C.EXIT_COMPLETE, "the writable-report control did not come back complete"
    assert rc_cannot == C.EXIT_CANNOT_CHECK
    assert rc_holes == C.EXIT_HOLES
    assert rc_report_failed == C.EXIT_REPORT_FAILED, (
        "a report that could not be written returned %s" % rc_report_failed)
    assert rc_report_failed not in (rc_complete, rc_cannot, rc_holes), (
        "the report-write failure shares an exit code with another verdict: "
        "complete=%s holes=%s cannot=%s report_failed=%s"
        % (rc_complete, rc_holes, rc_cannot, rc_report_failed))
